title: Is graph canonization polynomial-time reducible to graph isomorphism?
formal: Can a canonical labeled representative of every finite graph be computed in polynomial time using an oracle that decides graph isomorphism?
context:
Producing one isomorphism between a given pair is a different search problem. Canonization on restricted graph classes does not settle the general reduction.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Distinguishes recognizing structural equivalence from efficiently choosing a unique representative of each equivalence class.
